novelty_boundary: The candidate contribution is an empirical training constraint addressing actual normal-reference threshold transfer to business units, evaluated against a transparent same-information group-tail control. It does not claim a new quantile, hinge, max operator, calibration-gradient principle, unique temporal-direction mechanism, or population risk theorem.
